foundation-exhib-v4-ek2-ellsworth-kelly-.notes: The captioned Window III EK 2 is the right-hand work in the colour Philadelphia installation. White rectangular support, central vertical cord, upper paired horizontal lines, two shorter horizontal lines, lower paired cross-lines and lower zigzag cords follow the actually enlarged photograph. Very pale neutral lines diagram the shadows of WHITE cords; no gray pigment is asserted. Centre Pompidou curator Jean-Pierre Criqui independently describes Window III as a white monochrome with string sewn onto canvas. Line thickness and minor joins simplified; frame and wall excluded.
